name: Leaders-In-Training (LIT) Program (Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco
what_you_do: You take 10 hours of work training, then work about 7 hours a week for 10 weeks at a Clubhouse. You get coaching, explore careers, and build a professional portfolio.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 9 to 12 who are current Club members. Membership costs $20. Teens may take part only once per calendar year.
pay_detail: Teens who complete the requirements receive an $800 gift card.
duration: About 10 weeks: 70 hours of on-the-job experience after 10 hours of Work-Based Learning training.
deadline_text: Past cohorts began with a required training in January 2025 (Jan 11 to 18) and September 2025 (Sept 13 to 20). The 2026-27 training dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Join the Club ($20 membership) at kidsclub.org/register, then contact the High School Services Director or Clubhouse staff at your Clubhouse to sign up. You must attend one training session.
notes: Contact: Earl Declet, edeclet@kidsclub.org. The 2025-26 flyer lists LIT at these clubs: Willie Mays (Bayview), Excelsior, Don Fisher (Fillmore), Columbia Park and Mission (Mission), Tenderloin, and Springer (Sunnydale). Finishing LIT can lead to summer jobs. Teens under 18 cannot join the adult volunteer program. The site says to join a club, where there are youth volunteer roles. Club teens can also join Keystone Club. Its members raise at least $3,000 to go to a national meeting. The flyers do not say if you need a work permit.
